title: Product cards showed the brand, not the product
detail: Front page, shop index, category pages, compare header, guide product lists and the search index labelled a product with its brand only, so the two Chefman air fryers (P-01, P-03) printed as the identical string "Chefman" on the same card grid. A shopper could not tell them apart, and the cards read as template output. Fixed by adding a distinguishing name per product in data/products.json ('short', derived from the listing title, e.g. 'Chefman 6-Qt Dual Basket' vs 'Chefman 8-Qt TurboFry') printed on every card, the compare header, product-page h1 byline, breadcrumb and page title. The gate now fails if any product's distinguishing name is missing from index.html, shop.html or its own page.
owner_status: Fixed and gated. Does not block publication.

title: Double-escaped HTML entities printed literally on three pages
detail: guides.html and the two Holiday 2026 guides printed raw entity codes as visible text: readers saw "Seasonal guide · Holiday 2026" and "Air fryer capacity is not quarts — it is layers and minutes" spelled out as punctuation codes instead of an em dash and a middle dot, and one index-card summary printed the plus-or-minus sign the same way. Cause: entities written inside copy that is then HTML-escaped were escaped twice. Fixed in the generator by decoding entities before escaping, so a writer may type either an entity or the character itself. The gate now fails on any double-escaped entity sequence in any generated page.
owner_status: Fixed and gated. Does not block publication.

title: Guide images bypassed the caption, dimension and alt-text rules
detail: The two Holiday 2026 guide images were injected as raw '' tags outside the photo system: no intrinsic width/height (layout shift), no loading attribute, no figcaption. They also lived in assets/img/ while every other page image lives in assets/photos/ and passes the caption gate (FLG-036). Moved into assets/photos/ and rendered through the same captioned figure component as every other image. The gate now requires alt text, intrinsic width/height and a loading attribute on every on every page.
owner_status: Fixed and gated. Does not block publication.

title: Nine CSS classes were emitted with no stylesheet rule

They rendered as unstyled text inside styled cards, which is a large part of why the storefront read as assembled rather than published. Rules were added for each; no copy, value or claim was changed. A script comparing every class used in the HTML against the stylesheet now reports no unstyled classes.
owner_status: Fixed. Does not block publication.

title: Compare table implied prices and ratings were absent from the listings
detail: The Price and Star rating rows on compare.html read "not shown, by policy", and the surrounding copy implied those values were absent from the listings. They are not absent: the Product information / Item details block of each official listing publishes a buy-box price (which changes between visits), an average star rating, a review count and a Best Sellers Rank, in the same block as the specifications this site does quote. The site still reproduces none of them (Program Policies 2(b); FLG-005) and this flag deliberately prints no values either. What changed is the wording: compare.html and every product page now say the values exist on the listing and are excluded on purpose, so a reader is not told the data does not exist. Verify on any of the five listings (S10-S14), where the same table prints both the quoted specifications and the unquoted ratings.
owner_status: Wording corrected; exclusion stands. Does not block publication.

title: Spec citations name chunk numbers of a fetch that cannot be re-run
detail: Every field in data/products.json records where it was read, for example 'Product information - Features & Specs (chunk 7)'. The chunk number belongs to one specific page-fetch of that listing on 2026-11-20; a later fetch paginates differently (B08DKYBTPH's Product information table was chunk 7 in the original read and not the same position in a later one). The named table and field are stable and re-checkable by a human on the live page; the chunk number is not reproducible evidence. Left as-is because removing it would discard the record of how it was read, but a reader should trust the table name, not the chunk number. Re-verification should cite the table and field name only.
owner_status: Published for review. Does not block publication.

title: The analytics switch shipped in a file no page loaded
detail: assets/config.js documents window.SITE_CONFIG.analyticsEndpoint as the single place to turn cross-visitor measurement on, and disclosure.html and measurement.html both point readers at it. No page included the script, and assets/app.js never read SITE_CONFIG, so setting the endpoint would have done nothing and the site would have kept counting locally while the documentation said otherwise. Fixed: the page shell now loads assets/config.js before assets/app.js, and app.js reads window.SITE_CONFIG.analyticsEndpoint after the explicit window.SN_COLLECT_ENDPOINT and meta-tag overrides. The endpoint remains null in the repository, so no event leaves a reader's browser until the owner deploys a collector and sets it (FLG-010, Q-08). The gate now fails if any page stops loading config.js, loads it after app.js, or if app.js stops reading the setting.
owner_status: Fixed and gated. Does not block publication.
